name: Fairmont Scottsdale Princess
insider_take: Desert royalty meets championship golf in Scottsdale's most storied resort.
whats_special: This iconic resort sits on 65 acres beneath the McDowell Mountains and features two TPC golf courses that host the PGA Tour's WM Phoenix Open. The property's distinctive Moorish architecture and lagoon-style pools create an oasis feel, while the on-site spa utilizes indigenous desert botanicals in treatments.
pro_tip: Book tee times on the Stadium Course early – it's where the famous 16th hole "party atmosphere" happens during tournament week, and playing it any time of year is a bucket-list experience for golf enthusiasts.
dont_miss: The Sonoran Desert Casitas for ultimate privacy, sunset cocktails at the rooftop Sunset Bar overlooking the golf course, and the weekly outdoor movie nights by the pool during winter months. The resort's hot air balloon rides offer breathtaking views of the Sonoran Desert landscape.
pros: Championship golf courses with desert mountain views
Award-winning spa and multiple pools including lazy river
Authentic Southwestern architecture and desert landscaping
Multiple dining options from casual to fine dining
cons: Large resort property requiring shuttle or walking distances
Premium pricing for amenities and dining
